labels.text: does not accept images; switch to a vision model with /model first

steps: Start agi in a terminal and type /models <id> for a model whose Vision: row says no.
Type /attach and the path of an image file.
Read the refusal line: does not accept images; switch to a vision model with /model first.
Type /model, pick a vision model, then /attach the same image again and check it is attached.
S76.03.where: agi (chat), then /models <model id> (row Vision:), then /attach <image file>

S76.04.note: The per-model image limit is not shown in the CLI, so the tester must check the catalog for N.
steps: Pick a model and attach more images than that model allows, using /attach <image file> for each.
Type a question and press Enter to send.
Read the refusal: can read up to N images in one message. Remove N images to send it.
Compare N with the model's limit in the catalog; the CLI does not show the limit on /models.
S76.04.where: agi (chat), then /attach <image file> several times, then send a message

labels.text: Attach an image, PDF or Office file

S76.06.note: In Managed privacy mode the code does not send PDFs natively (chat.rs prepare_documents sets native_pdf to false), so results may differ by mode.
steps: Pick a model that shows P in the model list (row shows PDF: yes on /models <model id>).
Type /attach and the path of a PDF file, and read the attached confirmation.
Type a question about a specific page or passage in the PDF and press Enter.
Check the answer uses the PDF content.
S76.06.where: agi (chat), then /attach <file>, then send a message

S76.07.note: The code shows the audio flag but no audio attachment or gating path was found.
steps: Type /models <model id> for a model.
Read the Audio in/out: row, yes or no for input and output.
Type /attach and an audio file path to see whether audio can be attached.
Compare: the attach command rejects anything that is not an image, PDF or Office file, and no code gates audio input.

S76.08.needs: a microphone and either OPENAI_API_KEY set or a local whisper binary on PATH
S76.08.note: Voice picks the backend from OPENAI_API_KEY or a local whisper binary (voice.rs module notes); no registry lookup of a transcription model was found.
steps: Type /dictate and press Enter.
Speak one short sentence into the microphone.
Stop and check that the spoken words appear as text in the input.

labels.text: List the image models this account can generate with

S76.14.needs: a signed-in AGI account in Managed privacy mode
S76.14.note: The image model list comes from the server, so the names and limits depend on the account; the --count flag name was inferred from the command's argument list.
steps: Run agi image --list-models in a terminal.
Read the image model names listed for the account.
Run agi image "a red bicycle" --count N with N above the model's per-request maximum.
Read the refusal: makes at most N image per request, and check the image is not generated.
S76.14.where: agi image --list-models in a terminal, then agi image "<prompt>" --count N

labels.text: Flags: T=tools, V=vision, R=reasoning, P=reads PDFs, A=audio input. !=deprecated, B=beta.

S76.22.needs: a few files in the project folder
S76.22.note: The parallel-tool flag is read from the registry harness; the CLI shows no setting for it.
steps: Ask agi to read three different files in one request.
Watch whether the three read steps start together or one after another.

S76.23.note: No CLI control for multi-round tool use was found; the effect is visible only through the tool steps.

labels.text: This model takes no effort setting on this route, so the level applies once you switch to one that does

S76.26.needs: two models, one with effort support and one without
S76.26.note: Whether the picker filters levels to the catalog's supported levels was not confirmed.
steps: Type /effort and press Enter to open the effort picker.
Read the levels the picker offers for the current model.
Pick one level and read the reply Effort set to ...
Type /model to switch to a model with no effort setting and read: This model takes no effort setting on this route, so the level applies once you switch to one that does.

labels.text: does not accept a temperature, so your configured

S76.27.needs: a model that rejects sampling parameters
S76.27.note: The CLI does not list which models reject sampling; the tester must know one, and whether the note appears at start or at switch was not confirmed.
steps: Start agi with a temperature, for example agi -t 0.5.
Switch with /model to a model that rejects sampling parameters.
Read the chat line: does not accept a temperature, so your configured 0.5 is not sent to it.
S76.27.where: agi -t 0.5 (chat), then /model <model id that rejects sampling>

S76.28.note: Trimming or refusal of over-long requests was not confirmed in this search.
steps: Type /models <model id> and read Context window: in tokens.
Type /status and read the Context: percentage.
Compare with Expected: the tester should check whether a request over the limit is trimmed or refused.
S76.28.where: agi (chat), then /models <model id> (row Context window:) and /status (Context:)

S76.29.note: The cap on requests is applied in config.rs (stated_max_output_tokens) and cannot be seen on screen.
steps: Type /models <model id> and read Max output: in tokens.
Compare the figure with the catalog's output limit.
